name: 担当者別の作業負荷を可視化する初回空状態
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Asana workload empty state as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the 790 by 500 pixel crop. Keep a clean white background with no outer card, sidebar, toolbar or extra page chrome.

Across the upper two-thirds, reproduce the same compact bordered workload table, approximately x=50 to 748 and y=5 to 350 in the crop. It has exactly six equal-height rows and two columns: a left assignee column about 255 pixels wide, and a right workload chart area. Each row has one small circular portrait avatar at the same left position and one long pale-gray rounded name placeholder beside it. Do not add readable names. Use subtle light-gray horizontal row dividers and one thin vertical divider between the two columns.

In each row, draw the same thin pale-periwinkle stepped workload line across three equal time segments, with three small gray values centered above the line. Preserve the exact row values and their left-to-right order:
row 1: 2, 4, 8
row 2: 3, 3, 6
row 3: 1, 2, 1
row 4: 4, 2, 1
row 5: 1, 2, 1
row 6: 3, 3, 6
Match the source step-line heights and directions: row 1 rises twice, row 2 rises once near the right, row 3 rises then falls, row 4 falls twice, row 5 rises then falls, and row 6 rises once near the right. Keep the graph lines very thin and pale purple, grid and borders nearly white-gray, and values small, muted gray. Use six small varied but understated circular portraits, similar scale and treatment to the reference.

Below the table, center a bold dark heading at about y=402: 「チームの健全性を可視化」. Preserve the generous white gap between the table and heading. Under it, use one centered line of dark Japanese explanatory copy: 「期日を設定してタスクを割り当てると、ここに各担当者の作業負荷が表示されます。」. Follow it with the blue text link 「Workloadについて詳しく見る」 on a second centered line, matching the source link color and compact link style. Keep both lines within the lower 100 pixels and preserve the source spacing.

Use clean modern interface typography, similar in weight and size to the source. Keep the table, values, text, and link sharp and compact. Preserve the exact six-row data and composition. Do not add chart axes, legends, headers, names, numbers, decoration or content beyond the specified source elements. No English text except the word Workload in the learning link.
reviewNotes: The six-row workload chart and values match the reference closely. Needs correction: the explanatory sentence is centered, while the source begins left-aligned and the blue help link starts inline at the right then wraps to a centered continuation. Using the second allowed attempt to match that footer alignment.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
